entities.arbiter: The system/person that adjudicates receipts after outputs are frozen.
entities.controller: The TRIAXIS policy/module that routes evidence/actions around the scientific model.
entities.execution_backend: The environment/provider that supplies compute, filesystem, browser, network or sandbox.
entities.scientific_model: The model whose candidate answer/code is scientifically evaluated.

hard_rules: Execution backend identity must never replace scientific model identity.
A model/provider that helped design or tune the evaluated controller in the same adaptive stream is not clean independent confirmation.
Changing the controller after observing the same task output creates a new stratum; old/new outputs must not be pooled as one frozen protocol.
A backend-only execution of a pinned external model can validate compute/instrument execution but cannot be relabeled as the backend provider's model capability.
Oracle/hidden-label exposure before candidate/task freeze invalidates blind/prospective model claims.
Protocol changes after outcome forbid confirmatory promotion from that run.
Provider agreement is not independent evidence if all providers consume a shared leaked oracle or common invalid instrument.
